description: Set which tracking features the site's script includes. REPLACES the whole selection: send every feature you want enabled, not just the new one — anything omitted is turned off. Call get_tracking_settings first for the valid ids. Rebuilds and republishes the script, so the change reaches visitors after the CDN cache clears.

features.description: Feature ids to enable, from get_tracking_settings. The complete list, not a delta; [] disables every optional feature.

name: update_tracking_settings
